notes.title: New Patch 1.0.16

This patch touches many areas of the game  and should help make runs smoother and more fun.[/p][p align="start"]We’ve also expanded [b]Performance Mode[/b] with more optimizations![/p][p notes.title: Update Patch 1.0.14
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! Today we’re releasing [b]Performance Mode[/b], which should help a lot in some cases.
It disables lights, shadows, damage texts, health bars, and other elements.
This should improve the game’s base performance, and we hope it makes a big difference for you.[/p][p]In the coming days, we’ll be adding more improvements to Performance Mode, along with general fixes, addressing some serious performance issues with certain combinations.[/p][p]We hope you enjoy this update and the ones to come. We’re working hard to deliver an even better experience every time.[/p][list][*][p][b]Performance Mode:[/b] Added performance mode button to the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chickens:[/b] Chickens were invisible at the start of the match[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chicken Selection:[/b] Crash when switching chickens[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Effects:[/b] Improved mixing of multiple sound effects[/p][/*][*][p][b]Events:[/b] Adjustments to chicken coops[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leaderboard:[/b] Daily ranking table enabled[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fusion Stars:[/b] Star repositions when moving too far away[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stone Wall Ability:[/b] Stone walls were pushing Bosses and Semi-Bosses[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemies:[/b] Fixed visual bug with spitter puddles[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemies:[/b] Incorrect health bar position fixed[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skull Semi-Boss:[/b] Adjustments made to Skull Semi-Boss[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map 1 Boss:[/b] Prince jumped and did not return[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map 5 Enemies:[/b] Fixed XP drop from robots[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map 6 Semi-Boss:[/b] Fixed shock damage from Atlas[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map 7:[/b] Fixed visual issue with sandstorm[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map 7 Semi-Boss:[/b] Added shadow to the sphinx[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map 7 Boss:[/b] Improved camera movement visuals[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map 8 Enemies:[/b] Enemies appearing as white squares fixed[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map 8 Enemies:[/b] Frog aura was hard to see, now adjusted[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map 8 Enemies:[/b] Fixed incorrect death behavior for purgatory tadpoles[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for all the support and feedback — more updates are on the way![/p]

notes.title: Machick 2 is OUT NOW!
notes.content: [p align="start"][b]The wait is over — Machick 2 has finally hatched![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465320/77d49abb43cab852e61765c0305d3144498f6329.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]After months of chaos, spells, and frogs plotting in the shadows, the magical chicken is back and ready to face hordes of monstrous amphibians.[/p][p align="start"]Craft your wands piece by piece, fuse absurd spells, and collect relics and accessories that completely change the way you play. Every run is unpredictable, every boss is unique, and every build can mean the difference between victory… or becoming frog food.[/p][p align="start"][b]What’s new compared to the first Machick?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Even more frogs, bosses, and maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Relics and accessories to turn your chicken into pure madness.[/p][/*][*][p]Endless mode (because sometimes just surviving isn’t enough).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="b2YJo8Q9q2U;full"][/previewyoutube][p align="start"]This is the biggest project we’ve ever made — and none of it would exist without your wishlists, comments, and support along the way. Now it’s your turn to jump in, crush the frogs, and show us the craziest builds you can come up with![/p]
